modelingNotes: Exact identity: Weidmüller 1498700000, HDC HSB 6 MS, male screw-contact insert, size 6, six power poles and separate PE interface. The current exact-order datasheet is the identity/rating source; no facts are transferred from adjacent order 1498800000.

Numbering 1–6 is directly shown in the manufacturer RockStar catalogue 2006, printed B.88 (PDF p.120), male arrangement 3142 beside the table identifying 1498700000. In that drawing as printed, 1/3/5 occupy the right column and 2/4/6 the left, staggered; the earth symbol is at an end. The exact 2026 datasheet photograph corroborates molded numbers and end PE hardware. The current exact-order DXF front/back views show six contact positions but omit numeric marks; they are not numbering evidence. Physical coordinates and viewing conventions are not encoded by terminalOrder.

C.n and M.n are library aliases for the cable screw and mating-pin interfaces of the same numbered power contact, not two separate manufacturer marks. Six proposed fixed links C.1-M.1 through C.6-M.6 express continuity through each individual screw-contact/pin conductor. No link crosses numbered poles. Singleton functions and connector metadata do not join nets; explicit project fixed links must be authored separately.

PE is one aggregate protective-earth interface. The exact datasheet documents an M5 PE screw termination and shows PE hardware at the insert ends; it does not resolve every distinct PE clamp, mating spring or their internal bonds. No central PE pin, split C.PE/M.PE endpoints or PE fixed link is asserted. Aggregate PE intentionally leaves connection coverage partial.

PE.required=true is a library policy requiring the aggregate PE interface to appear in authored connectivity. It is not a manufacturer claim that all applications use every power pole and does not prove a protective-earth source, compliant external bonding, bond impedance or housing continuity. Power contacts are optional because their use is application-dependent.

Datasheet p.3 capability data are conditional: DIN EN 61984 rated current 35 A and voltage 400 V; UL/CSA rated voltage 600 V AC/DC. UR current is 35 A at AWG 10 and 8 A at AWG 12/14/16/18/20. cUR current is 8 A at each listed AWG 10/12/14/16/18/20. Preserve these surprising values exactly pending manufacturer clarification for any application relying on a higher approval-specific current. No scalar terminal current or nominal_voltage is authored from these capability limits.

Main-contact termination (datasheet p.4): screw M4, 0.5-6 mm² / AWG 20-10, 11 mm stripping, 1.2-1.5 Nm. PE termination: screw M5, rated 6 mm² / AWG 20-10, 10 mm stripping, 2-2.5 Nm. The family tightening-torque sheet separately corroborates HSB M4 main contacts versus M5 PE. Installation must use the instructions for the actual conductor and hardware revision.

Scope is the passive insert only. The 2006 numbered drawing and 2026 exact-order data are different source dates; installed-revision applicability, split PE hardware/bonds, mating counterpart, hood/housing bonding, environmental protection and approval-specific loading remain application checks. No housing, coding accessory, shield, neutral assignment or switch state is invented.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six numbered power contacts are represented at cable and mating interfaces, with six same-contact fixed links proposed separately. PE is an aggregate interface because the distinct physical PE terminations/mating features and their internal bonds are not fully established. Numbering 1–6 is directly verified on the exact-order 2006 manufacturer male diagram and corroborated by the current exact-order photograph; installed revision still requires confirmation. Hood/housing and external protective bonding are out of scope.
